description:
*“Ju-Won, I’m getting married.”*

After 15 long years of harboring a secret crush on Lee Hyun, Ju-Won ends up being rejected without ever having the chance to confess his feelings. He cuts off contact with Lee Hyun as if fleeing, and though he tries to forget him, he simply cannot bring himself to do so. Then one day, he receives a call from a drunk Lee Hyun. Ju-Won lets the heavily intoxicated Lee Hyun into his home, and the feelings he’s buried for so long resurface…

 *“Look closely. See who I’m kissing right now.”*

Lee Hyun is Ju-Won’s first love and the object of his unrequited affection, a secret he’s kept hidden from everyone. Will the two of them ever be together?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*Note: The sixth story in the Sachungi: Neoreul Saenggakaneun Bom (사춘기: 너를 생각하는 봄) Collection.*
